purpose: A primed direct named by-reference Generator carries its original cached cell and temporary supplied Exception through a catch suspension; source-name rebinding and running reentry retain the original cell.
source:
<?php
function Make62() {
    global $weakGiven;
    $value = new Exception('given62');
    $weakGiven = WeakReference::create($value);
    return $value;
}
function &Work62Rebind(&$cell) {
    global $weakGiven;
    try {
        echo 'SEED|';
        yield $cell;
        echo 'BAD-TAIL|';
    } catch (Exception $caught) {
        echo 'CAUGHT|', (int) ($caught === $weakGiven->get()), '|';
        Fiber::suspend('pause62');
        echo 'BODY|';
        yield $cell;
        echo 'AFTER-YIELD|';
    }
    return 62;
}
function Run62Rebind() {
    global $g;
    echo 'CALL|';
    $value = $g->throw(Make62());
    echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($value === 7), '|';
    return 'fiber62';
}
$slot = 5;
$old =& $slot;
$g = Work62Rebind($slot);
echo 'PRIME|', (int) ($g->current() === 5), '|';
$f = new Fiber('Run62Rebind');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'pause62'), '|';
$replacement = 9;
$slot =& $replacement;
$old = 7;
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|',
     (int) ($g->current() === 7), '|', (int) ($slot === 9), '|';
try {
    $g->next();
    echo 'BAD-REENTRY|';
} catch (Error $error) {
    echo 'ERROR|', (int) ($error->getMessage() === 'Cannot resume an already running generator'),
         '|', (int) ($error->getPrevious() === null), '|';
}
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume() === null), '|';
echo 'FIBER|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber62'), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 62), '|',
     (int) ($weakGiven->get() === null), '|';
unset($g, $f, $slot, $old, $replacement, $weakGiven, $error);
echo 'E';

purpose: Independent source: after catch unsets the old producer CV, a primed named by-reference THROW keeps the old object cache while parked and retires it at the next yield before caller continuation.

<?php
class Old62Review {
    public function __destruct() { echo 'DROP|'; }
}
function &Work62Review() {
    global $given;
    $old = new Old62Review();
    try {
        echo 'SEED|';
        yield $old;
        echo 'BAD-TAIL|';
    } catch (Exception $caught) {
        echo 'CAUGHT|', (int) ($caught === $given), '|';
        unset($old);
        Fiber::suspend('park62');
        echo 'BODY|';
        $new = null;
        yield $new;
        echo 'END|';
    }
    return 62;
}
function Run62Review() {
    global $g, $given;
    echo 'CALL|';
    $value = $g->throw($given);
    echo 'RESULT|', (int) ($value === null), '|';
    return 'fiber62';
}
$given = new Exception('given62');
$g = Work62Review();
$copy = $g->current();
$weak = WeakReference::create($copy);
unset($copy);
$f = new Fiber('Run62Review');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'park62'), '|';
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|',
     (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|',
     (int) ($g->current() === $weak->get()), '|';
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume() === null), '|';
echo 'FIBER|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber62'), '|',
     (int) ($weak->get() === null), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 62), '|';
unset($g, $f, $weak, $given);
echo 'E';
